protocol: Readout (v) at the no-gate-budget engine (agents/reference/trading-design.md's post-data note "the gate budget goes away"): mirror-table cost (three four-seat games an arm, board seeds 0/1/2, every seat the same preset, search2 the control, arms interleaved seed by seed, one process), plus trades/turn, the bundle-size distribution per executed trade (cards given, cards received), and the largest number of candidates a single clearing attempt asked. No bind rate: private gates are asked in public-surplus rank order until one clears or candidates run out, with no budget to bind.

ratio_noise_check.note: ms/move ratio measured 3x back-to-back (same process pattern each time); trades/turn, bundle sizes and max candidates asked are deterministic and identical across repeats -- only the ms/move ratio carries run-to-run noise from the box's load.
